body:
Heey resepignev here,

This Question is for the MapDev's.
But maybe you know something about this? or you just want to give feedback?
No problem! Post your minds!

So now to the Question: Is it possible to define NO player as Minotaur in the YML?
It would be a mix between Red Alert and Minotaur.
Red Alert: Noone who wants to kill you, all peaceful.
Minotaur: No blocks will disappaer under your feets.

Well when I think about it, it would be like king of the hill....

I suggested the Game: http://avicus.net/forums/230fcea6f
